opening.argument: The webinar ties business-building and token accumulation to a time-limited purchase promotion, promising that viewers who activate package codes will receive “10% more tokens” because “as more tokens equals more coins!” It reinforces that incentive with a defined deadline for package-code validity, membership and accumulation-based rewards, a sales threshold for a start-up bonus, free package codes, and a stated package benefit. The presentation also points to substantial reported leader earnings, stating that listed entries represent “$100,000,000 of earnings per year.” Members are directed toward leadership training and presentation events, while identity verification requires “a national ID card or passport if the address is shown.” The available evidence does not establish fulfillment, actual payments, victim loss, document misuse, or the economic value of the tokens and packages.
